note: renderMeetingDocument() rendered locally via node (no live Worker/D1 backend) for five synthetic City Council hearing/meeting records, one per participation-mode state named in the card. axe-core (test/functional/assets/axe.min.js) ran against each rendered document at both review widths using the same failing-violation classification as test/functional/11_accessibility.py (a11y_gate.py: critical/serious impact, plus the WCAG 2.2 target-size ratchet). Evidence proves the join/watch/in-person/written/unknown states render (A1-A6) and introduce no new axe violation; it does not evidence a live-data-populated card, since no Worker/D1 backend was running.

captures.assertion: A1: a recognized Zoom join URL renders "Join remotely" bound to that URL; the surrounding page (header, Where, contact, official source) renders unchanged
A1: same record at the wide review width — identical content, no reflow-introduced violation
A2: a broadcast-only YouTube link renders "Watch" (previously silently absent from this page) and never "Join online"
A2: same record at the wide review width
A3/A5: a venue address alone renders only the existing "Where" section — no register-to-testify or written-testimony action is added without its own evidence
A3/A5: same record at the wide review width
A6: a testimony-signup URL renders "Register to testify" bound to that URL while no attendance mode (join/watch/in-person) is asserted
A6: same record at the wide review width
negative rule: a record with no evidenced participation mode renders no participation-actions list at all, rather than a guessed default
negative rule: same record at the wide review width

pre_existing_violations_observed.note: Pre-existing on the shared meeting-document masthead/nav markup (site/meeting_document.mjs's <header class="document-mast">), present identically in the unknown-state baseline with no participation content at all; unchanged by this card's diff, which touches only the participation section. Left as-is rather than fixed out of scope, matching the meetings-attendance capture manifest's precedent for a pre-existing finding outside the card's diff.

accessibility.new_markup_scope_check: axe.run(document.querySelector('.meeting-participation')) returned zero violations at both viewports for the join_remote, watch, in_person, and written states — the new participation-actions markup itself introduces nothing.
